app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3Q.d.source: Create a new recipient list for organizing your contacts. Lists help you segment your audience for targeted marketing campaigns.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3Q.d.message: 建立新的收件者名單以整理您的聯絡人。名單有助於您細分受眾以進行精準行銷活動。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3Q.o.source: A descriptive name for your contact list. Choose a name that clearly identifies the purpose or audience of the list.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3Q.o.message: 聯絡人名單的描述性名稱。請選擇能清楚識別該名單目的或受眾的名稱。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Y3JlYXRlX2xpc3Q.o.source: The name of the new list

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.YWRkX29yX3VwZGF0Z.source: Add a new contact to your SendGrid contact database or update an existing contact if the email already exists. You can also assign the contact to one or more lists.

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.YWRkX29yX3VwZGF0Z.source: A JSON object containing custom field names and values. Custom fields must be created in your SendGrid account first.

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.YWRkX29yX3VwZGF0Z.source: The email address for the contact. This is the unique identifier - if a contact with this email exists, it will be updated.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.YWRkX29yX3VwZGF0Z.message: 聯絡人的電子郵件地址。這是唯一識別碼 - 若已存在包含此電子郵件的聯絡人，系統將會進行更新。

The last name of the contact

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.YWRkX29yX3VwZGF0Z.source: Lists to add the contact to

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.YWRkX2dsb2JhbF9zd.source: An array of email addresses to add to the global suppression list. These addresses will be blocked from receiving all future emails.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.YWRkX2dsb2JhbF9zd.message: 要新增至全域隱制名單的電子郵件地址陣列。這些地址未來將被阻止接收所有電子郵件。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2FsbF9ib3VuY.source: Retrieve bounces that were created before this point in time. Provide the time as a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch).
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2FsbF9ib3VuY.message: 擷取在此時間點之前建立的退信記錄。請以 Unix 時間戳記（自 Epoch 起算的秒數）提供時間。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2FsbF9ib3VuY.source: Filter bounces created before this Unix timestamp
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2FsbF9ib3VuY.message: 篩選在此 Unix 時間戳記之前建立的退信

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2FsbF9ib3VuY.source: The starting point in the list of results for pagination. Default is 0.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2FsbF9ib3VuY.message: 分頁結果清單的起始點。預設值為 0。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2FsbF9ib3VuY.message: 要傳回的最大退信筆數

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2FsbF9ib3VuY.source: Retrieve bounces that were created after this point in time. Provide the time as a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch).
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2FsbF9ib3VuY.message: 擷取在此時間點之後建立的退信記錄。請以 Unix 時間戳記（自 Epoch 起算的秒數）提供時間。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2FsbF9ib3VuY.source: Filter bounces created after this Unix timestamp
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2FsbF9ib3VuY.message: 篩選在此 Unix 時間戳記之後建立的退信

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2Jsb2Nr.opti.source: The email address to retrieve from the blocks list. This should be the exact email address that was blocked.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2Jsb2Nr.opti.message: 要從封鎖名單中擷取的電子郵件地址。這必須是遭到封鎖的確切電子郵件地址。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2Jsb2Nr.opti.source: The blocked email address to retrieve
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2Jsb2Nr.opti.message: 要擷取的已封鎖電子郵件地址

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2dsb2JhbF9zd.source: The email address to look up in the global suppression list. Returns the suppression details if found.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2dsb2JhbF9zd.message: 要在全域抑止清單中查詢的電子郵件地址。若找到，則傳回抑止詳細資料。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.Z2V0X2dsb2JhbF9zd.message: 擷取特定全域抑止電子郵件的詳細資訊

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.ZGVsZXRlX2Jsb2Nrc.source: Set to true to delete all blocked email addresses from your list. When true, the emails parameter is ignored.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.ZGVsZXRlX2Jsb2Nrc.message: 設定為 true 可從清單中刪除所有已封鎖的電子郵件地址。當為 true 時，將忽略 emails 參數。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.ZGVsZXRlX2JvdW5jZ.source: Remove email addresses from your bounces list. You can either delete all bounces at once or specify individual email addresses to remove. Deleting bounces allows those addresses to receive emails again.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.ZGVsZXRlX2JvdW5jZ.message: 從退信清單中移除電子郵件地址。您可以一次刪除所有退信記錄，或指定要移除的個別電子郵件地址。刪除退信記錄可讓這些地址再次接收電子郵件。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.ZGVsZXRlX2JvdW5jZ.source: Set to true to delete all bounced email addresses from your list. When true, the emails parameter is ignored.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.ZGVsZXRlX2JvdW5jZ.message: 設定為 true 可從清單中刪除所有退信電子郵件地址。當為 true 時，將忽略 emails 參數。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.ZGVsZXRlX2JvdW5jZ.source: An array of email addresses to remove from the bounces list. Required if Delete All is not set to true.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.ZGVsZXRlX2JvdW5jZ.message: 要從退信清單中移除的電子郵件地址陣列。若「全部刪除」未設為 true 則為必填。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9ibG9ja3M.o.message: 篩選在此 Unix 時間戳記之後建立的封鎖記錄

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.message: 篩選在此 Unix 時間戳記之前建立的抑止記錄

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.message: 分頁結果清單的起始點。預設值為 0。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.source: Starting point in the list of results
The maximum number of suppression records to return. Default is 500.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.message: 要返回的隱藏記錄最大數量。預設值為 500。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.source: Maximum number of suppressions to return
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.message: 要返回的隱藏記錄最大數量

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.source: Retrieve suppressions that were created after this point in time. Provide the time as a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch).
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.message: 擷取在此時間點之後建立的隱藏記錄。請以 Unix 時間戳記（自 Epoch 起的秒數）提供時間。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.source: Filter suppressions created after this Unix timestamp
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.message: 篩選在此 Unix 時間戳記之後建立的隱藏記錄

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.source: Retrieve a list of globally unsubscribed email addresses
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bGlzdF9nbG9iYWxfc.message: 擷取全域取消訂閱的電子郵件地址清單

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **SendGrid** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message:
使用已設定連線的驗證向 **SendGrid** 進行自訂 HTTP / REST API 呼叫。

指定 HTTP 方法、URI 路徑（相對於連線的 API 基礎 URL）、選填的查詢參數、標頭和請求主體。回應將以包含狀態碼、回應標頭和回應主體的雜湊返回。

對此應用程式尚未公開為一級動作的端點使用此動作。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 請求主體。有效類型取決於 `body_type`：JSON/表單/YAML 預期為雜湊，XML/文字預期為字串，multipart 預期為檔案結構，二進位預期為原始位元組。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 使用 `multipart/form-data` 上傳檔案。主體必須是 @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" 結構 (filename + content + mime_type)。框架會建立 multipart 信封並設定 boundary 標頭。
使用 multipart/form-data 上傳檔案

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Pass the body to the REST client unchanged; the client decides serialization based on its configured `data` option and the value type
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 將主體原封不動地傳遞給 REST 用戶端；用戶端會根據其設定的 `data` 選項與數值類型來決定序列化方式

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Pass-through; use connection serialization and let the REST client decide
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 透傳；使用連線序列化並由 REST 用戶端決定

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 將主體作為原始位元組傳送。主體必須是二進位值。除非被 `hdr` 覆寫，否則會設定 `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`。
將主體作為原始位元組傳送

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 將表單欄位的雜湊序列化為 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`。主體必須是值為純量 (字串/數字/布林值) 的雜湊。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Serialize body as application/x-www-form-urlencoded form fields
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 將主體序列化為 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 表單欄位

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Serialize the body as JSON; sets `Content-Type: application/json`. The body should be a hash, list, or scalar value.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 將主體序列化為 JSON；設定 `Content-Type: application/json`。主體應為雜湊、清單或純量值。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Send the body as plain text. The body must be a string. Sets `Content-Type: text/plain`.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 將主體作為純文字傳送。主體必須是字串。設定 `Content-Type: text/plain`。
將主體作為 text/plain 傳送

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Send the body as XML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to XML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/xml`.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 將主體作為 XML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 XML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/xml`。
將主體作為 XML 傳送

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Send the body as YAML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to YAML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 將主體作為 YAML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 YAML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`。
將主體作為 YAML 傳送

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Selects the body serialization mode and the corresponding `Content-Type` header. Changing this field reshapes the `body` editor - selecting JSON exposes a JSON editor, selecting Multipart Form exposes a file picker, and so on.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 選擇主體序列化模式與相應的 `Content-Type` 標頭。變更此欄位會重塑 `body` 編輯器 - 選擇 JSON 會顯示 JSON 編輯器，選擇 Multipart Form 會顯示檔案選擇器，依此類推。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: How the body is serialized and what Content-Type is sent
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 主體如何序列化以及傳送何種 Content-Type

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: If `True`, non-2xx HTTP responses return as the normal response hash (with the actual status code) instead of raising `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`. Useful for handling 4xx/5xx as data - e.g. checking whether a resource exists. Overrides the connection's `error_passthru` setting for this call only.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 若為 `True`，非 2xx 的 HTTP 回應將作為正常的回應雜湊 (包含實際狀態碼) 返回，而不是引發 `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`。適用於將 4xx/5xx 作為資料處理 - 例如檢查資源是否存在。僅針對本次呼叫覆寫連線的 `error_passthru` 設定。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Return non-2xx responses normally instead of throwing
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 正常返回非 2xx 回應，而不是拋出例外

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Optional list of HTTP status codes treated as success. If set and the response status is not in this list, the action throws `REST-STATUS-ERROR`. When unset, the REST client's default behavior applies (typically: 2xx is success, non-2xx throws).
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 視為成功的選擇性 HTTP 狀態碼清單。若已設定且回應狀態不在此清單中，該動作將拋出 `REST-STATUS-ERROR`。未設定時，套用 REST 用戶端的預設行為 (通常：2xx 代表成功，非 2xx 拋出例外)。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Response status codes treated as success
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 視為成功的回應狀態碼

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Hash of custom headers added to the request. These override any default headers set by `body_type` (e.g. supplying `Content-Type` here wins over the body-type default).
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 新增至請求的自訂標頭雜湊。這些會覆寫由 `body_type` 設定的任何預設標頭 (例如：在此處提供 `Content-Type` 會優先於主體類型的預設值)。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: If `True`, the response hash includes a `debug` sub-hash containing the request method/URL/headers (with sensitive values redacted), request and response sizes, and round-trip duration. Useful when investigating slow or failing calls. Off by default to keep responses lean.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 若為 `True`，回應雜湊包含一個 `debug` 子雜湊，其中包含請求方法/URL/標頭 (敏感值已遮蔽)、請求與回應大小以及來回時間。在調查過慢或失敗的呼叫時很有用。預設關閉以維持回應精簡。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Include request/timing/size debug info in the response
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 在回應中包含請求/時序/大小除錯資訊

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL. May contain `{name}` placeholders that are replaced from `path_vars`. Example: `/users/{id}/comments`.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 相於連線 API 基本 URL 的 URI 路徑。可能包含從 `path_vars` 替換的 `{name}` 預留位置。範例：`/users/{id}/comments`。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Hash of values substituted into `{name}` placeholders in the URI path. Example: with `path = /users/{id}` and `path_vars = {id: 123}` the framework sends `/users/123`. Values are URL-encoded.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 替換至 URI 路徑中 `{name}` 預留位置的值 Hash。範例：使用 `path = /users/{id}` 與 `path_vars = {id: 123}` 時，框架會傳送 `/users/123`。數值均經過 URL 編碼。
路徑中 {name} 預留位置的值

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Hash of query string parameters to append to the URI path. Values are URL-encoded; list values are joined with `,`.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 要附加至 URI 路徑的查詢字串參數 Hash。數值均經過 URL 編碼；清單值會使用 `,` 連接。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Make a custom API call to SendGrid
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.message: 向 SendGrid 發出自訂 API 呼叫

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VhcmNoX2NvbnRhY.source: Search your contact database for contacts matching a specific field value. You can search by email, name, or any custom field.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VhcmNoX2NvbnRhY.message: 在聯絡人資料庫中搜尋符合特定欄位值的聯絡人。您可以依電子郵件、姓名或任何自訂欄位進行搜尋。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VhcmNoX2NvbnRhY.source: The name of the field to search. Common fields include `email`, `first_name`, `last_name`, or any custom field name.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VhcmNoX2NvbnRhY.message: 要搜尋的欄位名稱。常見欄位包括 `email`、`first_name`、`last_name` 或任何自訂欄位名稱。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VhcmNoX2NvbnRhY.source: The value to match against the specified field. Text fields may require URL encoding.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VhcmNoX2NvbnRhY.message: 要與指定欄位相符的值。文字欄位可能需要進行 URL 編碼。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: Send a transactional email using a predefined SendGrid dynamic template. Customize the email content by providing dynamic template data for personalization.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 使用預先定義的 SendGrid 動態範本傳送交易式電子郵件。透過提供個人化的動態範本資料來自訂電子郵件內容。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: An array of email addresses to include as CC recipients.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 要包含為副本 (CC) 收件者的電子郵件地址陣列。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: An array of email addresses to include as BCC recipients.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 要包含為密件副本 (BCC) 收件者的電子郵件地址陣列。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: Optional name to display as the sender in the 'From' field.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 顯示在「寄件者」欄位中的選填寄件者名稱。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: The email address that will appear as the sender. Must be a verified sender in your SendGrid account.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 將顯示為寄件者的電子郵件地址。必須是 SendGrid 帳戶中已驗證的寄件者。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: Optional name to display for the reply-to address.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 回覆地址所顯示的選填名稱。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: Optional email address that recipients should reply to. If not provided, replies will go to the sender address.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 收件者應回覆的選填電子郵件地址。如果未提供，回覆將傳送至寄件者地址。
用於回覆的電子郵件地址

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: The email address of the primary recipient.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 主要收件者的電子郵件地址。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: Optional name of the recipient to personalize the 'To' field.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 用於個人化「收件者」欄位的選填收件者姓名。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: Select the dynamic template to use for this email. The template must be created in your SendGrid account.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 選取用於此電子郵件的動態範本。範本必須已在您的 SendGrid 帳戶中建立。
要使用的 SendGrid 範本

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: A JSON object containing key-value pairs for dynamic template data. These values will replace the corresponding placeholders in the selected template.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 包含動態範本資料鍵值組的 JSON 物件。這些值將取代所選範本中對應的預留位置。
用於範本個人化的動態資料

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.source: Send an email message using a SendGrid template
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF90ZW1wbGF0Z.message: 使用 SendGrid 範本傳送電子郵件訊息

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.de.source: Send a transactional email to one or more recipients. You can send plain text, HTML, or both. Supports CC, BCC, and custom reply-to addresses.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.de.message: 傳送交易式電子郵件給一位或多位收件者。您可以傳送純文字、HTML 或兩者皆傳送。支援副本、密件副本及自訂回覆地址。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.op.source: An array of email addresses to include as CC recipients.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.op.message: 要包含為副本 (CC) 收件者的電子郵件地址陣列。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.op.source: An array of email addresses to include as BCC recipients.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.op.message: 要包含為密件副本 (BCC) 收件者的電子郵件地址陣列。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.op.source: Optional name to display as the sender in the 'From' field.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.op.message: 顯示在「寄件者」欄位中的選填寄件者名稱。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.op.source: The email address that will appear as the sender. Must be a verified sender in your SendGrid account.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.op.message: 將顯示為寄件者的電子郵件地址。必須是 SendGrid 帳戶中已驗證的寄件者。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.op.source: The HTML version of the email content. Either text content or HTML content (or both) must be provided.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.op.message: 電子郵件內容的 HTML 版本。必須提供文字內容或 HTML 內容（或兩者）。
電子郵件的 HTML 內容

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.action.c2VuZF9lbWFpbA.op.source: The subject line of the email.
Optional name to display for the reply-to address.

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.desc.source: Integrate with Twilio SendGrid for comprehensive email management. Send transactional and marketing emails, manage your contact lists, validate email addresses for deliverability, and maintain your sender reputation by handling suppressions including blocks, bounces, and global unsubscribes. This integration provides full control over your email infrastructure and helps ensure high deliverability rates.
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.desc.message: 與 Twilio SendGrid 整合以進行全方位的電子郵件管理。傳送交易與行銷電子郵件、管理聯絡人清單、驗證電子郵件地址的可送達性，並透過處理封鎖、退信和全域取消訂閱等抑制清單來維持寄件者信譽。此整合提供對電子郵件基礎架構的完整控制，並協助確保高送達率。

app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.short_desc.source: Connect with SendGrid to send emails, manage contacts, and handle suppressions
app.U2VuZEdyaWQ.short_desc.message: 連接 SendGrid 以傳送電子郵件、管理聯絡人並處理抑制清單
